view_frame: The drawing presents a Front view (XZ plane) and a Top view (XY plane). The Front view displays the grille's width (X) and height (Z). The Top view displays the width (X) and depth (Y). The origin (0,0,0) is defined at the bottom-left corner of the grille body in the Front view.

features.section: Closed XY profile with internal loops
features.placement: Extruded along the Y-axis from Y=0 to Y=3. The profile is defined in the XZ plane (Front view) and swept along Y. The profile consists of an outer boundary and internal cutouts.
features.evidence: The Front view shows the grille outline with slots and headlights. The Top view shows a thin rectangular strip corresponding to the grille's depth. The user provided a uniform thickness of 3 mm.

connections: The grille_body is a single solid part.
The slots and headlights are through-holes (loops) within the grille_body profile.
edit_rules: Changing the 'uniform_thickness' parameter adjusts the extrusion depth (Y-axis) of the grille_body.
Changing the 'overall_width' parameter scales the X-dimensions of the grille_body profile.
Changing the 'overall_height' parameter scales the Z-dimensions of the grille_body profile.
